messages:
Jonah: thinking out loud — we need to pick a sampling strategy for OTLP spans that actually reduces egress cost but doesn't blind us when debugging SLO regressions :thinking:
Mira: agree. primary goals: cut exported spans, preserve error/latency signals and per‑route debugability. per-tenant floors probably required
Alex: can we do a hybrid? head sampling for known hot routes (low rate) + tail sampling for everything else (keep rare errors). sketch:```# pseudo
# policy svc returns {rate, min_floor}
decision = hash(route + tenant) % 10000 < rate*10000 or error_flag
```
Sophia: small nit — parent-based vs traceid sampling matters. parent-based lets services inherit decisions; but for tail sampling we often need to force-sample child spans when a late error shows up. keep a propagated tag `rd.force_sample=true` and have exporters respect it. also TTL retention for sampled trace ids (e.g., 10m) to catch delayed spans
Mira: how do we measure visibility loss? propose canary: pick 10 tenants (mix of small/med/large), run policy for 2 weeks, compare root-cause count and alert precision. also compare change in sampled-span volume and cost delta
Jonah: quick cost model sketch: exported_spans = total_spans * avg_sample_rate; cost = exported_spans * cost_per_span. we should compute per-route expected reduction using p95 span counts (since some routes spike). if we see routes with very high p95 but low error rate, we can be aggressive there
Alex: caution: deterministic hash sampling (traceid mod) will erase small tenants entirely if rate small. implement per-tenant min_floor: sampled_rate = max(global_rate_by_route, tenant_floor) and allow weighted overrides for enterprise customers
Sophia: implementation detail: policy service endpoints: `/v1/sampling?route=...&tenant=...` returns decision + reason. SDKs cache decisions for short window. fallback: if policy unreachable -> local probabilistic sampling at conservative rate. also add telemetry metrics: `sampling.decisions.{route}.{tenant}` counts for visibility
Mira: retention question — we can't retain full traces for everyone. propose 7d for sampled traces by default, 30d for enterprise retained via opt-in. tie retention to `x-rd-retain` header from policy
Jonah: rollout plan idea: 1) prototype policy svc + SDK hook in staging, 2) canary on 10 tenants (2 weeks), 3) metric comparators (error detection rate, median debug time), 4) gradual ramp by route category. owners: @Mira + @Alex. I'll open the rollout doc and link here
Alex: +1. will add a small snippet for OTEL sampler config that respects header and error flags
Sophia: also add a test that injects delayed error spans to validate TTL catch-up path
infra-bot: deploy started for `sampling-policy-proto` to staging at 1823459925 :rocket:
Jonah: ok, I'll create the doc and tag infra-sre + observability. nice work everyone :thumbsup:
